event_name: MOPAR NHRA Las Vegas Nationals powered by Dodge

pairs.note:
3:35 p.m. Weather conditions: air temperature 60 degrees, relative humidity 63 percent, barometer 29.72 inches, adjusted altitude 3,017 feet, track temperature 79 degrees.

Gadson is 5 - 1 against Oehler in prior events. 

Oehler gets the advantage off of the line but starts drifting left. He leans, trying to get the bike back in the groove, but finally has to back off of the throttle. Gadson's engine sounded like it bogged a little off of the line but he goes through with the win.

Gadson is going to his 17th final round, his eighth this year.

Herrera is 4 - 0 against Gladstone in prior events. 

They leave the line together but Herrera starts pulling away. Herrera drifts to the left, Gladstone drifts to the left, then both of them have to get off and on the throttle. Herrera hangs on and takes the win.

Herrera is going to his 38th final round, his fifth this year.

Gadson will have lane choice over Herrera in the final round.
